name: herald-connection
description: Send notifications to the owner's Mac through their own Herald relay, and be told when they reply.

interface.shortDescription: Notify your Mac and hear back
interface.longDescription: Connect Dotcliffe to the owner's Herald relay. Send banners and spoken notifications to their Mac, read delivery receipts, and read their typed or recorded replies. A reply can wake this conversation through the relay's notification.reply event once the platform subscription is verified. Text and presentation only: no commands, files or settings on the Mac.
interface.defaultPrompt: Send me a Herald notification and wait for my reply.
